title: Facility overview
text: The City Centre Vehicle Hub provides secure parking for cars and motorcycles. The facility is open to visitors, residents, and employees, with covered and open-air parking zones.

title: Location and access
text: The Vehicle Hub is located at 125 Central Avenue, beside the public library. Main vehicle access is from Central Avenue. The pedestrian entrance is beside the customer service desk.

title: Parking zones
text: The parking facility has three zones: Zone A for compact cars, Zone B for standard cars, and Zone C for motorcycles. Accessible bays are located beside the elevator and marked with the international accessibility symbol.

title: Reservation process
text: To reserve a parking space, choose a vehicle type and parking date, then provide an arrival time and duration. Confirm the displayed space and total before submitting. A reservation reference is generated after confirmation.

title: Cancellation policy
text: Reservations can be cancelled through the service desk before their arrival time. Free cancellation is available until 2 hours before arrival. Later cancellations may be charged at the facility's current hourly rate.

title: Security and valuables
text: The facility uses controlled entry, CCTV monitoring, and staff patrols. Drivers should lock their vehicles and remove valuable items. Do not leave children, pets, or restricted goods unattended.

title: Payment methods
text: Parking fees may be paid at the exit kiosk by card, mobile wallet, or a prepaid parking account. Cash is not accepted. Keep the reservation reference for payment verification.
